SELECT su.id, su.employee_no, su.username, su.real_name, su.phone, su.email, su.avatar_url, su.gender, su.status, su.last_login_at, su.created_at, sd.dept_name AS primary_dept_name FROM sys_user su LEFT JOIN sys_user_department sud ON su.id = sud.user_id AND sud.is_primary = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_department sd ON sud.department_id = sd.id AND sd.deleted = 0 WHERE su.deleted = 0
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_department sud2 WHERE sud2.user_id = su.id AND sud2.department_id = #{query.departmentId} )
AND su.status = #{query.status}
AND ( su.employee_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR su.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR su.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR su.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY su.created_at DESC
